summary: Crypto lending and yield company that suspended customer inflows and outflows in October 2020, filed Chapter 11 in November 2020, and later became the subject of federal wire-fraud convictions involving former executives.
what_happened: Cred accepted cryptocurrency through CredEarn and offered crypto-backed borrowing through CredBorrow. Financial stress and undisclosed business problems preceded a late-October 2020 account halt and a 7 November 2020 Chapter 11 filing. A liquidation plan became effective on 19 April 2021. Former executives later pleaded guilty to wire-fraud conspiracy and were sentenced in August 2025. No reviewed source establishes one completed recovery percentage for every customer class.
uncertainty_notes: The 2018 launch date is approximate. Plan effectiveness is not repayment completion, and final recovery varies by claim class.
notes: Centralized crypto interest-account, bankruptcy and misconduct case.
